purpose: Define a versioned, product- and domain-neutral, fail-closed curriculum and competence-evidence template for people affected by a future Neural Brain deployment. The template does not claim that any real person was trained or competent, process HR personal data, determine law, grant authority, approve a deployment, or authorize runtime operation.

verified_facts: Neural Brain is product- and domain-neutral and has no accepted scoped customer or domain integration.
The repository does not establish a concrete deployment, employer, worker population, affected-person group, training provider, learner record, qualification, or applicable legal duty.
The protected Memory Core is an internal subsystem and cannot narrow the complete cognitive-system product boundary established by ADR-018.
unknown_facts_not_inferred: whether any real person has completed, understood, retained, or applied a curriculum
the identity, employment, protected characteristics, performance, competence, authority, delegation, or availability of a real person
whether a concrete training, competence, personnel, regulatory, release, deployment, or runtime outcome is permitted

competence_template.assessment_unit: One immutable curriculum version or digest, role category, proposed deployment and intended-purpose version, authenticated Tenant, Area, and Project scope combination, and de-identified evidence-record reference where applicable.
competence_evidence_rules: A curriculum artifact and an evidence-record reference are separate: neither proves that a real person is trained, competent, authorized, or available.
Competence evidence must be de-identified or held in an independently governed personnel system; this repository stores neither HR personal data nor learner performance data.
A competence record never creates authority, delegation, approval, policy activation, authenticated identity, immutable scope, Gate ownership, or runtime access.

Required role separation remains binding: requester and elevated-risk approver, executor and independent verifier, policy author and sole policy activator, and Brain runtime and kill-switch authority cannot be collapsed by competence evidence.

Expiry, unknown status, incomplete evidence, failed reassessment, scope mismatch, conflict, or missing independent review where required blocks the affected role-dependent release or operation decision until separately governed evidence resolves it.

Refresh is required after material changes to intended purpose, enabled operation, model or artifact, supplier, data boundary, policy, Security Floor, incident pattern, role responsibilities, deployment scope, or applicable qualified-review requirement.

deterministic_order: Verify immutable curriculum version, role category, scope binding, de-identified evidence reference or explicit absence, assessment method, evidence time, expiry, and review trigger; any unknown, missing, stale, contradictory, or scope-mismatched item is incomplete.

Check whether an expiry or material-change trigger applies; if it does, preserve the prior evidence and create or link one separately governed reassessment work item with owner, next step, due date or trigger, and non-bypass release boundary.
Treat a refresh outcome as evidence only. It cannot alter authority, approvals, policy, transition gates, security controls, identity, scope, runtime permissions, protected state, or release state.
Close the reassessment work only through separately governed qualified evidence; completion of a learning activity alone is not an allow outcome.

authority_boundary.template_is: a versioned curriculum, de-identified competence-evidence, and refresh-cycle input for separately governed human oversight and release review
template_is_not: a claim that any real person was trained, competent, suitable, available, authorized, or supervised
an HR system, personnel record, performance assessment, employment decision, or processing of HR personal data
legal advice, a legal determination, a compliance certification, or a conclusion about an applicable obligation
an authority grant, delegation, policy decision, approval, authenticated runtime context, or Security Floor override
a protected-state transition request, Gate decision, runtime command, deployment approval, release approval, or runtime capability enablement
an implementation, maturity, recognition, safety, or production-autonomy claim
authority_boundary.non_bypass_boundary: Curriculum, evidence, expiry, refresh, and escalation records cannot waive, compensate for, reorder, or satisfy a Security Floor prohibition, Protected Control Plane gate, transition gate, independent verification, delivery-stage gate, recognition gate, release stop, or separately required approval.

current_blocker.unblock_condition: A concrete proposed deployment supplies immutable curriculum and role versions, authenticated scope, applicable qualified-review basis, independently governed de-identified competence evidence or explicit absence, current refresh evidence, required independence evidence, and a separate release or operation decision where required.
current_blocker.next_step: For each concrete deployment, create a scope-bound curriculum and de-identified evidence reference, then open reassessment work before relying on expired, changed, unknown, or incomplete role-dependent evidence.
